title: Pin widgetctl 4.2 until the upload regression is fixed
rule: ALWAYS pin widgetctl to 4.1 when deploying; 4.2 has an upload regression that drops the last chunk.
mechanism: Pinning the previous minor version avoids the truncated upload at the cost of missing 4.2 features.
context: Seen on acme ticket OPS-77 on 2026-10-01.

workaround.fix_condition: widgetctl ships a release that fixes the upload regression
